item.title: Man, teen killed in shootout during Rolex watch sale in Philadelphia: police
item.description: Investigators believe a deadly shooting erupted overnight Tuesday in Philadelphia during a watch sale between a 30-year-old man and a 16-year-old boy.Officers from the Philadelphia Police Department were called to the 500 block of Queen Lane just after 5 p.m. for reports of a shooting.Police found 30-year-old Tyree Ware and 16-year-old Quaneef Lee both suffering from gunshot wounds outside a 2016 Nissan Maxima.Both victims were taken to Temple University Hospital where they were pronounced dead.

item.title: Philadelphia police locate missing 84-year-old woman
item.description: Police have located an 84-year-old woman who went missing on Tuesday.The 84-year-old was last seen on the 5700 block of Warrington Street on Tuesday. In an update Wednesday evening, police say the woman has been located and was reunited with her family.
